description: Use this when the user wants a price for a specific charter trip with a bus, coach, minibus or van and driver: pickup, destination, date(s) and group size (for example '45-seat bus Tokyo to Hakone on 20 March for 40 people', a school trip, a company outing or a multi-day group itinerary). This is step 2 of the charter workflow, after or instead of search_charter_vehicles. Japan: returns the fixed 10-hour package price per vehicle per day, the number of vehicles and days, the overtime rate, and what is included or extra (tolls, parking, driver lodging). Europe (Schengen countries): returns an estimated price range from OlaChill's rate table. Every result is an estimate that OlaChill confirms after checking vehicle availability. Read-only: nothing is sent, saved or reserved. Do not use it to submit the request (use request_charter_quote once the user agrees), for bus or train tickets, or for 1–6 people on an airport run (use search_private_transfers).

date.description: Travel date as YYYY-MM-DD (Japan time for Japan trips).

destination.description: Main destination or 'round trip' area, e.g. 'Mt Fuji', 'Kyoto', 'Versailles'.

end_date.description: Last day for multi-day hire (omit for a single day) as YYYY-MM-DD (Japan time for Japan trips).

locale.description: Language for product names and page links (en, ja, ko, zh = Simplified Chinese, tw = Traditional Chinese, es, fr, de, it, th, id, vi). Default en.

pickup.description: Pickup city, airport, station or address area, e.g. 'Narita Airport', 'Shinjuku', 'Paris CDG'.

pickup_hour.description: Pickup hour 0–23 local time (used for night surcharges in Europe).

region.description: japan, or europe for Schengen countries.

trip_type.description: Default one-way for one date, multi-day when end_date is after date.

vehicle_type.description: Optional vehicle_type from search_charter_vehicles. Omit to use the recommended size.

name: get_charter_quote

error.description: Present only when the call failed; a short reason the user can act on.

estimated_price.description: Total for all vehicles and days. high is null when the price is a single package amount before extras.

title: Estimate a charter coach price
